newsitem.title: USA: Dow rallies higher, Nasdaq sees slight drop.
newsitem.headline: Dow rallies higher, Nasdaq sees slight drop.

text.p: The Dow industrial average hurdled higher on Thursday, up about 36 to 7612 in late morning trading.
The Nasdaq composite briefly hovered unchanged but then fell about 1.28 to 1407. The technology-laden market was weighed down by chip maker Intel Corp which was cut by Goldman Sachs and Cowen & Co.
Intel shares tumbled 3-1/2 to 144 in active trading.
The long bond was up 26/32 at a 6.78 percent yield while the Standard & Poor's futures index rose 4.45 to 875.
